senses.definition: An additional piece of information, an addition to existing information.
examples: I just made an update to my blog about my trip to Rome.

subsenses.definition: An advisement providing more up-to-date information than currently known.
examples: He gave me an update on the situation in New York.

senses.definition: A change in information, a modification of existing or known data.

subsenses.definition: A modification of something to a more recent, up-to-date version; (in software) a minor upgrade.
examples: Our database receives an update every morning at 3 AM.
I have a couple of updates to install on your laptop.
I just made an update to the Wikipedia article on guerrillas.

subsenses.definition: (statistics, computing) An adjustment of parametres in a model, or the rule by which they are adjusted.

senses.definition: (software) A version of something which is newer than other versions.
examples: You should try the update: it rocks.

quotes.text: The mid-season update for MW3 is here, introducing quite a bit of content across all three of CoD’s modes.
quotes.reference: 2024 March 6, John Esposito, “MW3 Zombies Season 2 Reloaded patch notes: New Schematics, Containment Levels, more”, in Dexerto:

senses.definition: (transitive) To bring (a thing) up to date.
examples: I need to update my records to take account of the most recent transaction.

senses.definition: (transitive) To bring (a person) up to date: to inform (a person) about recent developments.
examples: Update me on what happened while I was away.
